name: dumbbell step back lunge and row
description: A reverse lunge followed by a row. It trains the legs and the back in one flowing movement.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Hinge your torso slightly forward with a flat back.
Row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, push through the front foot to stand, and switch legs.
